subject: Onboarding: Orion Analytics — access & API key activation
messages:
From: Sylvia Park <sylvia.park@orionanalytics.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starting onboarding — admin invites + API keys

Hi Rachel / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team here is excited to get our tenant live. To avoid delays from our side, can you outline the exact artifacts you need from us to get admin invites and seed API access? Specifically:
- List of admin users we should provide (emails + roles)
- Expected timeline for seeding an initial API key and how long one-time keys remain valid
- Any IP allowlist or CIDR requirements for production calls

Also looping in our devs mailbox (devs@orionanalytics.com) and procurement for contract items they might need.

Thanks — Sylvia
Sylvia Park
Head of Product, Orion Analytics
[Attachment: org-capabilities-summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sylvia Park <sylvia.park@orionanalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starting onboarding — admin invites + API keys

Hi Sylvia — great to hear. Short answers up front, then a 5-step plan below.

Quick answers:
- Admin list: we typically need 2–3 initial workspace admins (emails + full name). We'll create one service account for server-side API calls and recommend one scoped machine user for CI.
- Seed API key: we can issue a time-limited seed key (30 days) to validate integration; we recommend switching to a long-lived service key paired with KMS on day 1 of production onboarding.
- IP allowlist: optional. If you want enforced egress CIDRs, share the prefixes; otherwise we use region controls and TLS.

Proposed 5-step onboarding plan (targets):
1) You share admin roster + procurement contact by EOD Wed (2025-07-23).
2) We provision a sandbox project (orion-sb-001) and seed a test API key within 24 business hours.
3) Karthik will validate auth flows and share example cURL/snippets.
4) We coordinate an invite batch for your admin users and a short admin walkthrough (30 min).
5) Move to prod project (orion-prod) and rotate to service key + KMS.

I attached an onboarding checklist that lists the specific fields we need for each admin. If that looks OK, Monica will open the provisioning ticket and Karthik will do the seeding.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior CS Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: onboarding-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sylvia Park <sylvia.park@orionanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starting onboarding — admin invites + API keys

Thanks — technical notes and recommendations below. Keeping this high signal so you can copy/paste into your runbook.

Project / keys:
- Sandbox name: orion-sb-001 (we'll create and share project id).
- Prod name: orion-prod (customer may pin any model versions per project).
- Seed key type: "ephemeral-test" (expires in 30d) for early validation. We'll create a separate "service" key (rotated by KMS) for production; we recommend storing service key secrets in your vault and only granting KMS decrypt to CI runners.

Roles mapping (recommended starter set):
- Workspace Admin: full UI and key management (only 2–3 people)
- Developer: can create projects and generate local API keys (devs@orionanalytics.com can be a group)
- Billing Viewer: procurement contact only

SSO / Provisioning:
- If you want SSO SAML now, send over IdP metadata (we support SAML 2.0). Otherwise invites will be via email and you can attach to your SSO later.

Attachments: I attached a small macros file showing example RBAC JSON snippets and an instructions PDF for key rotation.

I'll standby for the admin list so I can kick off project creation.

— Karthik
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: orion-macros.jsonl (text); dot-keys-instructions.pdf (pdf)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sylvia Park <sylvia.park@orionanalytics.com>, devs@orionanalytics.com
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@orionanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Starting onboarding — admin invites + API keys

Thanks everyone — summarizing agreed next steps and owners (actionable checklist):

1) Sylvia / Orion: Provide admin roster (full name, email, preferred role from list) + procurement contact by 2025-07-23 EOD. Owner: Sylvia. (procurement@orionanalytics.com copied)
2) Redwood: Create sandbox project (orion-sb-001) and seed ephemeral test API key within 24 business hours of receiving roster. Owner: Rachel / Jonas.
3) Redwood SE: Share auth snippets and RBAC JSON for local testing. Owner: Karthik (will send by tomorrow).
4) Joint: 30-min admin walkthrough demo (propose Wed 07/24 11:00–11:30 PT) — confirm availability. Owner: Monica to calendar.
5) Security: If Orion requires IP allowlisting or SSO, please provide details in your admin roster so we can set that while provisioning.

Procurement note: If you need a PO or a DocuSign for the initial contract addendum, we can surface the standard SOW. Rachel — can you share the HubSpot deal link and SOW stub?

Sylvia — once you send the admin list I will open the internal provisioning ticket and attach the checklist.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[Quoted text from Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com> at 13:02:00 — showing recommended roles and project names]
